newsitem.title: USA: TAG Heuer names Louis-Dreyfus next chairman.
newsitem.headline: TAG Heuer names Louis-Dreyfus next chairman.

text.p: TAG Heuer International SA said Monday that Robert Louis-Dreyfus will take over as chairman of the company's board at its next meeting, in succession to current chairman Richard Hanson.
The company said that Louis-Dreyfus, together with Claude Frey, were named as new board directors at the annual general meeting held in Luxemburg on Monday.
Louis-Dreyfus is president of the Executive board of Adidas AG, while Frey is a Swiss minister of parliament from the Canton of Neuchtel, the state where the TAG Heuer's executive offices are based.
